background_notes.fact: For the K-linear isomorphism τ:V_K→Q and K-subspace W⊆V_K, Z=τ(W) is a K-subspace. If a K-linear endomorphism a of V_K preserves W and bτ=τa, then b preserves Z.

background_notes.fact: A K-subspace W⊆V_K is preserved by the induced x,y,h operators if and only if it is preserved by the induced action of every element of (ℤx+ℤy+ℤh)⊗_ℤ K.

background_notes.justification: Each tensor is a finite sum of pure tensors, and an element of ℤx+ℤy+ℤh is an integer linear combination of x,y,h. Its induced action after tensoring is therefore a K-linear combination of their three induced operators. Closure of W under scalar multiplication and finite sums proves forward stability. Conversely, x⊗1, y⊗1 and h⊗1 give the three operators, so invariance under the whole action implies their invariance.
